definitions.full: H4622. matsor מַעְצוֺר noun [masculine] restraint, hindrance ; — ׳מ 1Sam 14:6 followed by infinitive, ׳י has no hindrance in delivering.

occurrences.englishText: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that Yahweh will work for us; for there is no restraint on Yahweh to save by many or by few.”
